title: GitHub Says Copilot Reports Missed Agent Activity, Leaving Gaps That Cannot Be Recovered
key_facts: Copilot usage metrics showed agent activity and agent lines of code falling while overall usage kept growing; GitHub found the cause.
Several IDEs moved Copilot agent sessions to the Copilot SDK; those sessions did not identify their IDE, so most of that activity was left out and some was counted as Copilot CLI activity.
The fix is available in Visual Studio Code; other IDEs should get it by November 2026.
GitHub cannot backfill the missing data, so affected developers stay undercounted until they update.
Copilot CLI metrics may be inflated and cannot be corrected for earlier periods.
quote_evidence: Most of that activity was left out of reports, and some was counted as Copilot CLI activity.
why_it_matters_hint: Companies that track AI-coding adoption with Copilot dashboards have been working from undercounts.
